what: The upstream revision every recorded number was measured against. Each experiment calls hf_hub_download or snapshot_download with no revision=, so a run took whatever main pointed at that day and nothing recorded which bytes those were. These are those bytes, read back out of the Hugging Face caches the runs actually used.

how.aicr: python scripts/upstream_revision.py scan --cache /scratch/qi_zim_neu/olmoearth_inferenceX/hf, run inside an srun on the cpu partition; the readings below were taken with the equivalent find over refs/main
how.again: python scripts/upstream_revision.py check asks the Hub what main points at now and names what has moved

what_this_is_not: Not a generator's output. This is a measurement of someone else's system at a point in time and cannot be recomputed, only re-measured. A revision of null means the sha was not recoverable, and the entry says why rather than being left out.
cross_checks: allenai/olmoearth-paper-embeddings read the same in two separate cache trees on aicr, which the experiments populated on different days.
allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-Base, allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-Nano and isp-uv-es/WorldFloodsv2 read the same on aicr and on the laptop: two machines, two independent downloads, one sha each.
coverage: Thirteen repositories. scripts/upstream_revision.py finds eight of them by scanning the code for repo ids on fetcher lines and top-level constants; that scan is a lower bound, since a repo id assigned inside a function (allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-Base, at oe_inferencex/taskcard.py:265) is not reached. The record may pin more than the scan finds, never less, and the test asserts that direction.

125oii/dfc2020.carries: DFC2020, the land-cover testbed of exp66

Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.carries: the smaller agent of the exp64 benchmark

Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B.carries: the bf16 weights behind the NVFP4 quantisation exp64 serves

allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-Base.carries: the v1 Base encoder almost every map in the record was inferred with

allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-FT-AWF-Base.carries: the fine-tuned AWF head of exp21

allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-Nano.carries: the smallest size of the series

allenai/OlmoEarth-v1_2-Base.carries: the v1.2 Base encoder, the second checkpoint of the difference atlas

allenai/olmoearth-paper-embeddings.carries: the sixteen encoders' embeddings over Ai2's twenty-four published tasks; every suite experiment reads them, directly or through exp54 and exp70

allenai/olmoearth_lcc.why: Held in neither cache, so there is no sha to read back. oe_inferencex.taskcard fetches its README to fill a task card's provenance fields; no recorded number rests on it, and a re-upload would change a citation, not a result.
allenai/olmoearth_lcc.carries: the served land-cover product's dataset card

gastruc/anysat.why: Fetched by torch.hub.load from GitHub, not from the Hub. torch.hub caches by branch rather than by commit, so the cache cannot be read back for a sha, and exp39's AnySat comparison is therefore the one upstream dependency in the record that is genuinely unpinnable as run.
gastruc/anysat.carries: AnySat, the outside representation of exp39 and exp41

isp-uv-es/WorldFloodsv2.carries: WorldFloods v2, the post-event optical arbiter of exp62

links-ads/geoid-flood.carries: GEOID-Flood, the multi-event testbed of exp55 and exp61

nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4.carries: the quantised agent exp64 serves under vLLM

orion-ai-lab/Kuro-Siwo-Webdataset.carries: Kuro Siwo, the null pair of the evidence hunt
